description: This file defines the public interface for Ethernet management in the Zephyr networking stack, including request commands, event definitions, and event-raising functions.

methods.name: ethernet_mgmt_raise_carrier_on_event
methods.description: Raises an event indicating Ethernet carrier is on (connected).

methods.name: ethernet_mgmt_raise_carrier_off_event
methods.description: Raises an event indicating Ethernet carrier is off (disconnected).

methods.name: ethernet_mgmt_raise_vlan_enabled_event
methods.description: Raises an event indicating VLAN has been enabled on the interface.

methods.name: ethernet_mgmt_raise_vlan_disabled_event
methods.description: Raises an event indicating VLAN has been disabled on the interface.
